key_insight: OvAi Focus combines ultrasound segmentation and IOTA-based morphology extraction to make ovarian and adnexal mass interpretation more objective.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support more consistent gynecological ultrasound reading for healthier ovaries and suspicious adnexal masses, where operator subjectivity is a major challenge.
method: Segmented healthy ovaries, solid components, and cystic components in adnexal masses
Extracted morphology keywords based on IOTA definitions
Compared segmentation outputs with ground truth masks and morphology outputs with interobserver agreement
evidence_signal: In the abstract, segmentation DICE scores ranged from 0.62 for functional ovary to 0.87 for whole adnexal mass, while morphology agreement showed Fleiss Kappa of 0.16 to 0.57 and percent agreement of 47% to 90%.
watch_item: Performance is still variable across structures and morphology labels, so real-world robustness and generalizability need careful validation before adoption.
paper_title: OvAi Focus: A framework for multiclass segmentation and morphological features extraction in gynecological ultrasound
